title: Core Paid Media Campaign Details
description: Campaign-specific details and configuration fields for paid media campaigns

xdm:campaignDetails.title: Campaign Details
xdm:campaignDetails.description: Specific details for paid media campaigns

xdm:startTime.title: Start Time
xdm:startTime.description: When the campaign becomes active/starts running

xdm:campaignType.title: Campaign Type
xdm:campaignType.description: Primary campaign channel type. Maps to Google Ads advertising_channel_type. For automation-specific classification, see automatedCampaignType.

xdm:subType.title: Campaign Sub-type
xdm:subType.description: More specific campaign sub-type or format. Maps to Google Ads advertising_channel_sub_type for non-automated variants (e.g., VIDEO_NON_SKIPPABLE, VIDEO_SEQUENCE).

xdm:promotedObject.title: Promoted Object
xdm:promotedObject.description: Object being promoted by the campaign

xdm:isCampaignBudgetOptimization.title: Campaign Budget Optimization
xdm:isCampaignBudgetOptimization.description: Whether campaign uses automatic budget optimization

xdm:dailyBudget.title: Daily Budget
xdm:dailyBudget.description: Daily budget amount in account currency

xdm:lifetimeBudget.title: Lifetime Budget
xdm:lifetimeBudget.description: Total lifetime budget amount in account currency

xdm:spendCap.title: Spend Cap
xdm:spendCap.description: Maximum amount that can be spent

xdm:schedule.title: Schedule
xdm:schedule.description: Day-of-week and time-of-day windows during which the campaign is eligible to serve

xdm:dayOfWeek.title: Day of Week
xdm:dayOfWeek.description: Day of the week this schedule entry applies to

xdm:startHour.title: Start Hour
xdm:startHour.description: Hour of the day the schedule window opens, expressed in 24-hour format (0-23)

xdm:endHour.title: End Hour
xdm:endHour.description: Hour of the day the schedule window closes, expressed in 24-hour format (0-23)

xdm:pixelIDs.title: Pixel IDs
xdm:pixelIDs.description: Tracking pixel IDs associated with campaign

xdm:ios14CampaignType.title: iOS 14 Campaign Type
xdm:ios14CampaignType.description: Campaign type for iOS 14+ attribution handling

xdm:skanEnabled.title: SKAN Enabled
xdm:skanEnabled.description: Whether SKAdNetwork (Apple's attribution framework) is enabled for this campaign

xdm:appProfilePageEnabled.title: App Profile Page Enabled
xdm:appProfilePageEnabled.description: Whether App Profile Page is enabled for the campaign

xdm:isAutomatedCampaign.title: Is Automated Campaign
xdm:isAutomatedCampaign.description: Whether this campaign uses platform-level automation with machine learning optimization. Should be true for inherently automated campaign types (e.g., performance_max, smart, demand_gen) and platform automation features (e.g., TikTok Smart+, Meta Advantage+).

xdm:automatedCampaignType.title: Automated Campaign Type
xdm:automatedCampaignType.description: Cross-platform automation product classification. Only populated when isAutomatedCampaign is true. Normalizes automation approaches across platforms. Not a direct 1:1 mapping of any single platform field. For Google Ads, automated sub-types from advertising_channel_sub_type (e.g., SMART_CAMPAIGN, APP_CAMPAIGN) map here.

xdm:catalogId.title: Catalog ID
xdm:catalogId.description: Product catalog identifier for catalog-based campaigns

xdm:catalogAuthorizedBusinessCenterId.title: Catalog Authorized Business Center ID
xdm:catalogAuthorizedBusinessCenterId.description: Business Center ID that authorized the catalog access

xdm:productSource.title: Product Source
xdm:productSource.description: Source of products for the campaign

xdm:storeId.title: Store ID
xdm:storeId.description: Online store identifier (e.g., TikTok Shop ID, Amazon Store ID)

xdm:storeAuthorizedBusinessCenterId.title: Store Authorized Business Center ID
xdm:storeAuthorizedBusinessCenterId.description: Business Center ID that authorized the store access

xdm:placementBidAdjustments.title: Placement Bid Adjustments
xdm:placementBidAdjustments.description: Bid adjustment percentages by ad placement

xdm:placement.title: Placement
xdm:placement.description: Placement identifier (e.g., TOP_OF_SEARCH, PRODUCT_PAGE, HOME, DETAIL_PAGE)

xdm:additionalDetails.title: Additional Campaign Details
xdm:additionalDetails.description: Platform-specific campaign details not defined in core schema. Allows ingestion of arbitrary fields from paid media network APIs without requiring schema changes.
